contractDecision.reason: Recovered implementations across the available WOM versions contain a commented-out creation body and no maintained frontend or business-module caller uses this public endpoint. Restoring the legacy body would reintroduce simulated login, string-built SQL and partial multi-order transaction risk.
contractDecision.compatibilityBehavior: The URL remains available for compatibility and returns HTTP 200 with business code 400 plus an explicit deprecated message; it never creates or updates a manufacturing instruction.
supportedReplacementPaths: POST /msService/WOM/produceTask/produceTask/produceTaskCreated2 with authentication for daily-plan integration
/msService/WOM/produceTask/produceTask/makeTaskList -> 新建指令单 for authenticated manual entry

evidence.databaseResult: PostgreSQL marker count remained 0 before and 0 after the retired endpoint request.
evidence.browserResult: makeTaskList returned 200, the 新建指令单 button was visible, manual-entry/page loaded two product options, and console/page/request/network errors were all zero.

sourceTrace.callerAudit: Repository-wide source search found server definitions and historical analysis only; no maintained frontend or business-module caller invokes the public endpoint.
sourceTrace.finding: The recovered body is commented out and the unpatched method returns false success. The maintained runtime now rejects the legacy contract explicitly and never delegates to the unsafe body.

closedDecision.reason: The legacy endpoint is not a supported product capability. Its explicit rejection is a PASS retirement contract, not a manufacturing-create PASS.
